# Sarx

> Free wellness calculator generating BMI, TDEE, and body fat percentage
> using peer-reviewed formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor, Katch-McArdle,
> Harris-Benedict). No account required. Data is never saved.

## Docs

- [Health Index Calculator](https://sarx.app/): Enter age, sex, weight, height, and activity level to receive your Health Index.
- [Learning Library](https://sarx.app/learning/): Evidence-ranked wellness guides by clinical priority.
- [About Sarx](https://sarx.app/about/): Formulas used, methodology, and creator background.

## Learning Library — Supplements

- [Creatine Monohydrate](https://sarx.app/learning/creatine-monohydrate/): The most-studied supplement in sports science. 5g daily for strength, muscle mass, and high-intensity performance.
- [Magnesium Glycinate](https://sarx.app/learning/magnesium-glycinate/): 200–400mg evening. Supports sleep quality, reduces muscle cramps, and counteracts stress-elevated cortisol.
- [Vitamin D3 + K2](https://sarx.app/learning/vitamin-d3-k2/): 2,000–5,000 IU with fat. D3 raises serum levels; K2 directs calcium to bones, not arterial walls.
- [Fish Oil (EPA/DHA)](https://sarx.app/learning/fish-oil/): 2–3g combined daily. Reduces systemic inflammation, supports cardiovascular health, and improves body composition.
- [Whey Protein](https://sarx.app/learning/whey-protein/): 20–40g post-workout. Fastest-digesting complete protein. Use when whole food protein isn't accessible.
- [Zinc Picolinate](https://sarx.app/learning/zinc-picolinate/): 15–30mg evening. Supports testosterone, immunity, and wound healing. Picolinate form absorbs better than zinc oxide.
- [Ashwagandha KSM-66](https://sarx.app/learning/ashwagandha/): 300–600mg daily. Evidence-backed for cortisol reduction and stress adaptation. Effects build over 4–8 weeks.
- [Caffeine](https://sarx.app/learning/caffeine/): 3–6mg/kg body weight, 30 min pre-workout. One of the most effective performance enhancers. Hard cutoff at noon.

## Learning Library — Health

- [Daily Protein Target](https://sarx.app/learning/daily-protein-target/): 0.7–1.0g per pound of bodyweight per day. Primary driver of muscle protein synthesis.
- [Daily Fiber Target](https://sarx.app/learning/daily-fiber-target/): 14g per 1,000 calories. Feeds gut bacteria, slows glucose absorption, and reduces LDL cholesterol.
- [Daily Water Target](https://sarx.app/learning/daily-water-target/): Half your bodyweight in fluid ounces per day. Individualized baseline that scales better than fixed recommendations.
- [Gut Health](https://sarx.app/learning/gut-health/): Fermented foods and reducing ultra-processed foods are the two highest-impact levers for microbiome health.
- [Circadian Rhythm](https://sarx.app/learning/circadian-rhythm/): Sleep schedule, morning sunlight, caffeine timing, meal cutoff, room temperature, and screen habits — the full picture.
- [Electrolytes](https://sarx.app/learning/electrolytes/): 1–2g sodium during training. Replaces sweat losses and prevents hyponatremia at high training volumes.
- [Progressive Overload](https://sarx.app/learning/progressive-overload/): Add stimulus over time — weight, reps, or quality. Without it, adaptation stops.
- [Workout Essentials](https://sarx.app/learning/workout-essentials/): Compound movements, 2x/week frequency, training near failure, volume targets, and rest periods.
- [Apple Cider Vinegar](https://sarx.app/learning/apple-cider-vinegar/): Trend warning. The alkalizing mechanism doesn't survive stomach acid. Evidence is weak and manufacturer-funded.
